links.comparator_used: Baseline PPD model without debiasing, and 5 debiasing approaches compared (fairness through blindness and reweighing variants)
links.outcome: Model fairness (disparate impact, equal opportunity, predictive parity) and predictive performance
links.effect: Fairness through blindness yielded the best overall performance and fairness among the debiasing approaches; the baseline model showed some unfairness in AMC data. No numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We revised the model by fairness through blindness, a debiasing approach that yielded the best overall performance and fairness, while considering clinical appropriateness suggested by the expert reviewers.

design_hint: pre-implementation fairness evaluation, threshold selection, and debiasing
